reasoning_steps: Identify the properties of the triangles.
Note that both triangles ABC and ABD are isosceles.
Since BD is perpendicular to AC, angle BDE is 90 degrees.
In triangle ABD, since AB = BD, angle ADB is 60 degrees.
In triangle ABC, since AB = AC, angle ACB is 60 degrees.
Summing up the angles, angle C + angle D equals 120 degrees.
